XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for tiny_muai test cases

TABLE.NAME: tiny_muai_testcase
TABLE.COMMENT: Saved test cases for the tiny_muai test cases admin tool

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable name of the test case (globally unique)

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle context id passed to generate_ai_response

FIELD.NAME: page
FIELD.COMMENT: HTML id of the page body tag

FIELD.NAME: editorcontext
FIELD.COMMENT: HTML id of the editor textarea

FIELD.NAME: editorcontent
FIELD.COMMENT: Text content sent to the AI

FIELD.NAME: nameparam
FIELD.COMMENT: Value of the HTML id_name field on the simulated page

FIELD.NAME: previousresponse
FIELD.COMMENT: Previous AI response, used to simulate Check revised

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: User who last modified the test case

TABLE.NAME: tiny_muai_testcase_run
TABLE.COMMENT: History of test case executions for tiny_muai

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who ran the test case

FIELD.NAME: inputs
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot of the inputs that were used for this run

FIELD.NAME: systeminstruction
FIELD.COMMENT: System instruction in effect on the AI provider when this run was dispatched

FIELD.NAME: prompttext
FIELD.COMMENT: Full prompt text sent to the AI for this run

FIELD.NAME: success
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the run completed successfully, 0 if it threw an exception

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Exception message captured if the run failed
